description:
This course introduces the mathematical concepts and foundations needed to talk about the three main components of a machine learning system: data, models, and learning. Upon this course, students will be able to understand: • Foundametal concepts about matrices and matrix decomposition.
• Concepts of gradients.
• The basics of probability and some distributions.
• Optimization to find maxima/minima of functions. • Dimensionality reduction using principal component analysis.
• Classification in the context of support vector machines.
Method of teaching and learning: Lecture and project based learning
